title: Thoughts upon slavery
author: John Wesley

authorInfo.bio: John Wesley (1703–1791) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Thoughts upon Slavery" by John Wesley is a polemic essay written in the late 18th century. This work examines the moral and ethical implications of slavery, particularly focusing on the African slave trade and the conditions faced by enslaved individuals.
